nodes.name: Conjecture 1.1: *+[F] Conjecture
nodes.statement: The closure of each $GL(V)$-orbit in $V \times \mathcal{N}$ is normal.

nodes.name: Theorem 7.3: *+[F]
nodes.statement: For every $(\mu;\nu)\in\mathcal{Q}_n$, $\overline{\mathcal{O}_{\mu;\nu}}$ is regular in codimension~$1$.

nodes.name: Theorem 5.3
nodes.statement: If $\dim (\Lambda_{(r_i),I} \smallsetminus \Lambda^\circ) \le d_{(r_i),I} - 2$, then $\Psi^{-1}(0) \cong \Lambda_{(r_i),I}$, and this variety is a normal complete intersection of dimension $d_{(r_i),I}$.

nodes.name: Theorem 4.11
nodes.statement: If $\Lambda_{\mu;\nu} = \Lambda_{(r_i),I}$ is a normal variety, then $\overline{\mathcal{O}_{\mu;\nu}}$ is normal.
